CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_master_export(p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_pais pais_code_enum DEFAULT NULL::pais_code_enum)
 RETURNS TABLE(track_artist_concat text, tempo_id text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
    return query
    select tm.track_artist_concat, tm.tempo_id
    from tracks_master tm
    left join territory_tracks tt
        on tt.track_master_id = tm.id
       and tt.deleted_at is null
       and (p_pais      is null or tt.pais_code = p_pais)
       and (p_date_from is null or tt.snapshot_date >= p_date_from)
       and (p_date_to   is null or tt.snapshot_date <= p_date_to)
    where tm.deleted_at is null
      and (
        (p_pais is null and p_date_from is null and p_date_to is null)
        or tt.id is not null
      )
    group by tm.track_artist_concat, tm.tempo_id
    order by tm.track_artist_concat;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_master_view(p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_pais pais_code_enum DEFAULT NULL::pais_code_enum, p_include_deleted boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, track_artist_concat text, track_name_clean text, tempo_id text, last_chart_date date, deleted_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
    return query
    select tm.id, tm.track_artist_concat, tm.track_name_clean, tm.tempo_id,
           max(tt.snapshot_date) as last_chart_date, tm.deleted_at
    from tracks_master tm
    left join territory_tracks tt
        on tt.track_master_id = tm.id
       and tt.deleted_at is null
       and (p_pais      is null or tt.pais_code = p_pais)
       and (p_date_from is null or tt.snapshot_date >= p_date_from)
       and (p_date_to   is null or tt.snapshot_date <= p_date_to)
    where (p_include_deleted or tm.deleted_at is null)
      and (
        (p_pais is null and p_date_from is null and p_date_to is null)
        or tt.id is not null
      )
    group by tm.id, tm.track_artist_concat, tm.track_name_clean, tm.tempo_id, tm.deleted_at
    order by max(tt.snapshot_date) desc nulls last, tm.track_artist_concat;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_merge_tempo_duplicates(p_tempo_id text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    v_survivor uuid;
    v_merged integer := 0;
begin
    -- Solo IDs numéricos: los marcadores con palabras se repiten a propósito.
    if p_tempo_id is null or p_tempo_id !~ '^[0-9]+$' then
        return 0;
    end if;

    select id into v_survivor
    from tracks_master
    where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null
    order by created_at asc
    limit 1;

    if v_survivor is null then
        return 0;
    end if;

    select count(*) into v_merged
    from tracks_master
    where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor;

    if v_merged = 0 then
        return 0;
    end if;

    perform set_config('app.allow_hard_delete', 'true', true);

    -- territory_tracks: si el sobreviviente ya tiene esa combinación, se
    -- descarta la del duplicado; si no, se le reasigna.
    delete from territory_tracks tt
    where tt.track_master_id in (
            select id from tracks_master
            where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor)
      and exists (
            select 1 from territory_tracks s
            where s.track_master_id = v_survivor
              and s.pais_code = tt.pais_code
              and s.snapshot_date = tt.snapshot_date
              and s.platform = tt.platform);

    update territory_tracks
    set track_master_id = v_survivor, tempo_id = p_tempo_id
    where track_master_id in (
            select id from tracks_master
            where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor);

    -- territory_bo_report
    delete from territory_bo_report tb
    where tb.track_master_id in (
            select id from tracks_master
            where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor)
      and exists (
            select 1 from territory_bo_report s
            where s.track_master_id = v_survivor and s.pais_code = tb.pais_code);

    update territory_bo_report
    set track_master_id = v_survivor
    where track_master_id in (
            select id from tracks_master
            where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor);

    -- territory_tempo_report
    delete from territory_tempo_report tr
    where tr.track_master_id in (
            select id from tracks_master
            where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor)
      and exists (
            select 1 from territory_tempo_report s
            where s.track_master_id = v_survivor and s.pais_code = tr.pais_code);

    update territory_tempo_report
    set track_master_id = v_survivor
    where track_master_id in (
            select id from tracks_master
            where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor);

    delete from tracks_master
    where tempo_id = p_tempo_id and deleted_at is null and id <> v_survivor;

    update tracks_master set estado_bo = 'ok'
    where id = v_survivor and estado_bo = 'duplicada';

    return v_merged;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_norm_tempo_id(v text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
    -- Para valores numéricos saca los ceros de relleno; para marcadores
    -- con palabras ("NOP", "PENDIENTE") devuelve el texto tal cual.
    select case
        when v is null then null
        when trim(v) ~ '^[0-9]+$' then ltrim(trim(v), '0')
        else upper(trim(v))
    end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_obra_history(p_track_master_id uuid, p_pais pais_code_enum)
 RETURNS TABLE(changed_at timestamp with time zone, changed_by text, bo text, ca text, estado text, reclamos text, mech_bo text, estado_trabajo text, perf_tempo text, mech_tempo text, estado_obra text, created_date text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
    return query
    with ids as (
        select id, 'territory_bo_report' as t
        from territory_bo_report
        where track_master_id = p_track_master_id and pais_code = p_pais
        union all
        select id, 'territory_tempo_report'
        from territory_tempo_report
        where track_master_id = p_track_master_id and pais_code = p_pais
    ),
    eventos as (
        select al.changed_at as ts, al.changed_by as usuario, al.table_name as tabla, al.new_data as datos
        from audit_logs al
        join ids on al.row_id = ids.id and al.table_name = ids.t
        where al.new_data is not null
    ),
    momentos as (
        select distinct on (date_trunc('minute', e.ts))
               e.ts, e.usuario
        from eventos e
        order by date_trunc('minute', e.ts), e.ts desc
    ),
    fotos as (
        select
            m.ts,
            m.usuario,
            case when (bs.datos ->> 'bo_id') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                 then ltrim(bs.datos ->> 'bo_id', '0')
                 else bs.datos ->> 'bo_id' end  as f_bo,
            bs.datos ->> 'ca'                   as f_ca,
            bs.datos ->> 'bo_status'            as f_estado,
            bs.datos ->> 'reclamos'             as f_reclamos,
            bs.datos ->> 'mech_bo'              as f_mech_bo,
            bs.datos ->> 'estado_trabajo'       as f_trabajo,
            ts2.datos ->> 'perf_pc'             as f_perf,
            ts2.datos ->> 'mech_pc'             as f_mech,
            ts2.datos ->> 'estado_obra'         as f_obra,
            ts2.datos ->> 'created_date'        as f_created
        from momentos m
        left join lateral (
            select e2.datos from eventos e2
            where e2.tabla = 'territory_bo_report' and e2.ts <= m.ts
            order by e2.ts desc limit 1
        ) bs on true
        left join lateral (
            select e3.datos from eventos e3
            where e3.tabla = 'territory_tempo_report' and e3.ts <= m.ts
            order by e3.ts desc limit 1
        ) ts2 on true
    ),
    con_huella as (
        select f.*,
               concat_ws('|',
                   coalesce(f.f_bo,''), coalesce(f.f_ca,''), coalesce(f.f_estado,''),
                   coalesce(f.f_reclamos,''), coalesce(f.f_mech_bo,''), coalesce(f.f_trabajo,''),
                   coalesce(f.f_perf,''), coalesce(f.f_mech,''), coalesce(f.f_obra,''),
                   coalesce(f.f_created,'')) as huella
        from fotos f
    ),
    con_anterior as (
        select h.*, lag(h.huella) over (order by h.ts) as huella_anterior
        from con_huella h
    )
    select a.ts, a.usuario, a.f_bo, a.f_ca, a.f_estado, a.f_reclamos, a.f_mech_bo,
           a.f_trabajo, a.f_perf, a.f_mech, a.f_obra, a.f_created
    from con_anterior a
    -- Solo si cambió algo respecto de la foto anterior.
    where a.huella_anterior is null or a.huella_anterior <> a.huella
    order by a.ts desc;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_procesar_tempo_historico(p_limite integer DEFAULT 5000)
 RETURNS TABLE(estado text, filas bigint, pendientes bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    v_filas bigint[];
    v_arr   jsonb;
begin
    -- Próximo lote sin procesar, en orden de fila (sin tablas temporales).
    select array_agg(x.fila order by x.fila),
           jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('track_artist', x.concatenate, 'tempo_id', x.tempo_id) order by x.fila)
      into v_filas, v_arr
    from (
        select s.fila, s.concatenate, s.tempo_id
        from staging_tempo_historico s
        where not s.procesado
        order by s.fila
        limit p_limite
    ) x;

    if v_arr is null then
        return;   -- no queda nada pendiente
    end if;

    -- idx (1, 2, 3...) es la posición en el lote; v_filas[idx] es la fila original.
    insert into resultado_tempo_historico (fila, concatenate, tempo_id, estado, detalle)
    select s.fila, s.concatenate, s.tempo_id, b.estado, b.detalle
    from fn_carga_historica_tempo_batch(v_arr) b
    join staging_tempo_historico s on s.fila = v_filas[b.idx]
    on conflict (fila) do update
        set estado = excluded.estado, detalle = excluded.detalle, procesado_at = now();

    update staging_tempo_historico
    set procesado = true
    where fila = any(v_filas);

    return query
    select r.estado, count(*)::bigint,
           (select count(*) from staging_tempo_historico st where not st.procesado)::bigint
    from resultado_tempo_historico r
    where r.fila = any(v_filas)
    group by r.estado
    order by 2 desc;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_territory_export(p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_pais pais_code_enum DEFAULT NULL::pais_code_enum)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
    select
        v.pais_code::text,
        v.track_artist_concat,
        coalesce(v.created_date::text, ''),
        coalesce(v.tempo_id, ''),
        coalesce(v.bo, ''),
        coalesce(v.ca, ''),
        case when v.perf_raw ~ '^[0-9.]+$' then v.perf_raw || '%' else coalesce(v.perf_raw, '') end,
        case when v.mech_raw ~ '^[0-9.]+$' then v.mech_raw || '%' else coalesce(v.mech_raw, '') end,
        coalesce(v.estado, ''),
        coalesce(v.reclamos, ''),
        coalesce(v.mech_bo::text || '%', ''),
        coalesce(v.estado_trabajo, '')
    from fn_territory_view(p_date_from, p_date_to, p_pais, false) v
    order by v.pais_code, v.track_artist_concat;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_territory_view(p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_pais pais_code_enum DEFAULT NULL::pais_code_enum, p_include_deleted boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, track_master_id uuid, pais_code pais_code_enum, tempo_id text, track_artist_concat text, snapshot_date date, created_date date, bo_report_id uuid, bo text, ca text, perf_raw text, mech_raw text, estado text, reclamos text, mech_bo numeric, estado_trabajo text, estado_obra text, deleted_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
    return query
    select distinct on (tt.track_master_id, tt.pais_code)
        tt.id, tt.track_master_id, tt.pais_code, tm.tempo_id, tm.track_artist_concat,
        tt.snapshot_date, tr.created_date,
        br.id, br.bo_id, br.ca,
        coalesce(tr.perf_raw, tr.perf_pc::text),
        coalesce(tr.mech_raw, tr.mech_pc::text),
        br.bo_status, br.reclamos, br.mech_bo,
        br.estado_trabajo, tr.estado_obra, tt.deleted_at
    from territory_tracks tt
    join tracks_master tm on tm.id = tt.track_master_id
    left join territory_bo_report br
        on br.track_master_id = tt.track_master_id and br.pais_code = tt.pais_code
    left join territory_tempo_report tr
        on tr.track_master_id = tt.track_master_id and tr.pais_code = tt.pais_code
       and tr.deleted_at is null
    where (p_include_deleted or (tt.deleted_at is null and tm.deleted_at is null))
      and (p_date_from is null or tt.snapshot_date >= p_date_from)
      and (p_date_to   is null or tt.snapshot_date <= p_date_to)
      and (p_pais      is null or tt.pais_code = p_pais)
    order by tt.track_master_id, tt.pais_code, tt.snapshot_date desc;
end;
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_upsert_ranking_row(p_track_name text, p_artist_names text, p_pais_code pais_code_enum, p_rank integer, p_peak_rank integer, p_previous_rank integer, p_weeks_on_chart integer, p_streams bigint, p_source text, p_uri text, p_platform text DEFAULT 'spotify'::text, p_weekly_growth numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_snapshot_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(territory_id uuid, track_created boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
    v_master_id uuid; v_tempo_id text; v_created boolean; v_territory_id uuid;
    v_artist text := coalesce(nullif(trim(p_artist_names), ''), 'Sin artista');
begin
    insert into tracks_master (track_name_raw, artist_name_raw, tempo_id, bo_id, estado_bo)
    values (p_track_name, v_artist, null, null, 'uncontrolled')
    on conflict (lower(track_name_clean), lower(artist_name_clean)) where deleted_at is null
    do update set updated_at = tracks_master.updated_at
    returning id, tempo_id, (xmax = 0) into v_master_id, v_tempo_id, v_created;

    insert into territory_tracks (
        track_master_id, tempo_id, pais_code, rank, peak_rank, previous_rank,
        weeks_on_chart, streams, source, uri, platform, weekly_growth, snapshot_date
    ) values (
        v_master_id, v_tempo_id, p_pais_code, p_rank, p_peak_rank, p_previous_rank,
        p_weeks_on_chart, p_streams, p_source, p_uri, p_platform, p_weekly_growth, p_snapshot_date
    )
    on conflict (track_master_id, pais_code, snapshot_date, platform)
    do update set
        rank = excluded.rank, peak_rank = excluded.peak_rank, previous_rank = excluded.previous_rank,
        weeks_on_chart = excluded.weeks_on_chart, streams = excluded.streams, source = excluded.source,
        uri = excluded.uri, weekly_growth = excluded.weekly_growth, tempo_id = excluded.tempo_id,
        deleted_at = null, updated_at = now()
    returning id into v_territory_id;

    return query select v_territory_id, v_created;
end;
$function$
;
